notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCISION release, new games in the catalog, and more Realms Deep 2023 news from Hyperstrange
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/1699b1f20e514af85e9d00ea02a216d728938311.png[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrangers![/h1]

It is [i]that[/i] time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

[h2]INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers![/h2]
[previewyoutube=qlgqps4wcbU;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734680/INCISION/
Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

[h2]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=xoMT9iW_690;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/
POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude! 

[h2]Blood West - Chapter 2 announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ll6tFR5ebg4;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West
Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

[h2]Supplice - release date announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=2YS2ZCjBTnw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice/
According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: [b]30 march 2023[/b]!

[h2]77p Egg: Eggwife - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=OXD0zCu0rJw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317020/77p_egg_Eggwife/
We fell in love with Eggwife after first seeing it in the Realms Deep 2021 showcase. Now, after we've released POSTAL: Brain Damaged it's perfectly clear, that the audience wants us to take things a step further. Or a lot of steps further. To go so far, that we'll end up in UK. Eggwife is what would happen if the Brits came up with POSTAL, but... it's so much more. An immersive sim? A dating sim? A shopping cart driver sim? You name it! Maybe just go wishlist it, and get the Demo for you to plau

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qAiV6YUVacM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/
We strive to bring overlooked, original titles to a broader audience. Sometimes originality isn't apparent at face value. What seems like an arena shooter with retro stylings happens to become a whole sprawling world full of adventure and danger. You can find out for yourself just what makes Ghostware so unique that it found its way to our hearts. We'e not sure of the release date yet with this one, but we do highly encourage you to wishlist it and take the available demo for a spin.

And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

[h2]Your's truly,[/h2]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/0703e4c0718a8efe5be90b59356042bc0910a9e2.png[/img]

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition (OST & Art Book bundle!) + upcoming updates!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/fbb0539e05676ff94aa2b21c71c2b025479b62c1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hyperstrange friends, RWS fam![/h1]

Hyperstrange-developed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/url], the action-packed DOOM Eternal-like spin-off of the POSTAL series is finally here, and  if you own any of the eligible RWS or Hyperstrange titles, or some other staple throwback-shooters like DUSK, Hedon, or Nightmare Reaper, you can get PBD with an additional discount added on top of -20% release discount [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/][b]via one of the special bundle deals[/b][/url].

Plus, we're happy to report it really SLAPS! With more than 1100 reviews it currently enjoys an 'Overwhelmingly Positive' rating, with more than 95% players recommending the game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/18684ae3b765836c7dde86fa69ffe2737dfcac06.gif[/img]

Yes, Hyperstrange really pulled this one off. The game is good and the release has been relatively bug-free despite the 2-week delay made explicitly to implement some bugs and stay on-brand. But it wouldn't be a POSTAL release if something haven't gone wrong. Many of you were waiting for the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged/]POSTAL: Brain Damaged Official Soundtrack[/url]. The wait is finally over! The OST has arrived, and you can get it separately or bundled with the official Art Book in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26678/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged__Connoisseur_Edition][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=q7UXDk9xsaM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]UPCOMING UPDATES[/h1]

The Hyperstrange Dev team is very grateful for the amazing reception of PBD. This gives them even more motivation to improve and expand the game post-release. Here's what to expect soon:

[list]
[*] [b]Post-release fix [/b]- an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release (ETA: One week)
[*] [b]Balancing update[/b] - some players, as well as [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ld5VPBIQeSM]some internet micro-celebrities[/url], have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)
[*] [b]New playmodes[/b] - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
[*] [b]More to be announced![/b]
[/list]

Hyperstrange and RWS are both extremely pleased with the reception of [b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b]. We're as excited as you are, to see what the future will bring to this explosive and twisted spin-off.

[b]Your true friends and family,[/b]
[h2]Hyperstrange & RWS[/h2]

notes.title: RAYZE 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]RAYZERS![/h1]

It's time to attack those leaderboards again - RAYZE 2.0 (also known as Season 2) is here, with new tracks, lot's of polish, and quality-of-life improvements. Get your gaming mouse in fighting shape, cause it won't be a walk in the digital park.

[previewyoutube=xM3epb9Xv3E;full][/previewyoutube]

The update comes with:

[list][*] New "Time Attack" mode with brand new tracks and leaderboards to conquer
[*] Revamped main menu
[*] Leaderboard display and sync performance improved
[*] Option to turn off the impact particle explosion
[*] Option to turn of the warp chain visualisation
[*] Option to toggle screen shake on and off
[*] Option to choose your crosshair style[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE/
The update comes with a special promo - you can get RAYZE 30% off (starting 10am PT), so tell your friends and frenemies that you want to race in the leaderboards.

[h2]Ready? 3... 2... 1...[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41049280/6117e9373c17c746526f9c411b606805daa48a80.png[/img]

notes.content:
Added launch options to disable particle effects and screen shake. 

[list]
[*]To disable screen shakes add "-noshake" to launch options. 
[*]To disable particle effects add "-novfx" to launch options.
[/list]

notes.title: New and Shiny RAYZE 1.9 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]RAYZERS![/h2]

Welcome to your [b]*New & Shiny RAYZE*[/b]. The first post-release update takes the [i]aim racer[/i] concept so many people fell in love with, and turns the dial to 11 to make sure the game is even more bombastic. We're grateful for your feedback, that helped us greatly in giving the game a new layer of fine polish. With nearly all reviews on Steam being positive, we know we've got something special here. If you have RAYZE sitting idly on your wishlist, here's your cue to find out what's it all about - the game is 25% off this week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

If you've already spent some time playing RAYZE, chances are you'll feel like you're playing a whole new game. The changes to the look and feel are so substantial, we were tempted to dub this release [b]RAYZE 2.0[/b], but we decided to keep that one for later and settle for 1.9 instead. So what's changed? You'll notice instantly - why not see for yourself?

[previewyoutube=l6G8TCz5FnE;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think of the changes! Or - of you're a new player - come and say hi, and tell us how are you enjoying RAYZE. The [url=https://discord.gg/jyVCjBFZKe]official Discord server[/url] would be the best place to do it! Want to know more? See the full changelog below:

[h2]Full RAYZE v.1.9 changelog:[/h2]
[list][*] anti cheat for speed hacks implemented
[*] added different fullscreen mode variants in settings
[*] updated crosshair look, animation and functionality
[*] added crosshair scale settings
[*] mouse input should be noticeably even more raw
[*] updated mouse sensitivity settings with 3 floating points
[*] added panel warp particle effect for 
[*] added energy tunnel particle effect to indicate trajectory
[*] baked occlusion culling in all the levels
[*] jukebox doesn't appear when music is disabled
[*] some SFX were updated
[*] redesigned 3_5 (map is now static without moving elements with more warp possibilities)
[*] cars on 4_3  (don't drive on players route anymore)
[*] visual changes for improved visibility on levels 5_4, 6_1, and 6_2[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

RAYZERS! Today's update brings RAYZE much closer to what we'd consider [i]aim racer perfection[/i], but we know there's more you folks expect of us. Namely - more levels. The second season is underway, and it will bring a slew of new levels to explore, overcome, and master. We just need to make sure we have enough players to keep things interesting, so by all means - make some noise! Got a friend who might enjoy our bite-size speedruns? Tell them today!

The next update, worthy of the [b]RAYZE 2.0[/b] name, will coincide with the Nintendo Switch release, so expect to see controller support in RAYZE at that point (and probably a separate set of leaderboards). For now, please enjoy the new look of your [b]all-time favorite aim racer[/b] (we can say that, we're the first one of the genre, after all!).

[b]Ready? 3... 2... 1...[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41049280/6117e9373c17c746526f9c411b606805daa48a80.png[/img]
